title: Ex 1.3 #4 · Subsets of ∅
prompt: List all the subsets of $\emptyset$. Enter them together as one set of sets between outer braces, like $\{\emptyset, \{1\}\}$.
answer_format: A set of sets between braces, like {∅, {1}, {1, 2}}. Spaces are optional.
hints: The empty set has no elements to choose from, but it still has one subset.
A set with k elements has 2ᵏ subsets, including ∅ and the set itself: here that's 1.
solution: The set has 0 element(s), so it has 1 subset(s), from ∅ up to the whole set.

reference.note: This exact exercise, restated in ProofLab's words.
